---
name: aidlc
description: Start or resume AI-DLC structured development
---

## Steps

1. Read AGENTS.md for the core AI-DLC workflow
2. Check if `aidlc-docs/` exists (resume) or not (fresh start)
3. Determine: greenfield (new project) or brownfield (existing code)
4. If `prework/` exists, read vision.md and any requirements docs first
5. Begin **Inception**: workspace detection → requirements → stories → design → units
6. Present each stage output for approval before proceeding
7. After inception approved: enter **Construction** — functional design → NFR → code → build/test
8. One unit at a time for code generation stages
9. After construction: enter **Operations** if deployment is in scope
